# nix-cache-discovery options

## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.enable



Whether to enable a LAN-discovering Nix binary cache\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.package



The nix-cache-discovery package to run\.



*Type:*
package



*Default:*

```nix
<derivation nix-cache-discovery-0.1.0>
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.allowedClients

Client prefixes allowed to connect and the only prefixes the daemon
probes during discovery\. Requests from any other address are answered
with 403\. An empty list uses
` services.nix-cache-discovery.discovery.ranges `\. Ignored while
` services.nix-cache-discovery.discovery.auto ` is enabled\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```



*Example:*

```nix
[
  "192.168.1.0/24"
]
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.discovery\.auto



Use the connected network’s subnet at startup for discovery and the
client allowlist\. Explicit discovery ranges are ignored while this
is enabled\. The firewall opens the cache port to private, link-local
and unique-local addresses, never to internet addresses\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.discovery\.interval



Seconds between discovery scans\.



*Type:*
positive integer, meaning >0



*Default:*

```nix
60
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.discovery\.ranges



Prefixes scanned for other instances on the configured port\. Local
subnets inside these ranges are scanned first\. At most 65536
addresses in total\. Ignored while discovery\.auto is enabled\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```



*Example:*

```nix
[
  "192.168.1.0/24"
]
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.discovery\.timeout



Milliseconds allowed for each probe\. Wi-Fi round trips of several
hundred milliseconds are normal, and a probe timeout below that
makes a healthy peer look gone and evicts it\.



*Type:*
positive integer, meaning >0



*Default:*

```nix
1500
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.discovery\.workers



Number of concurrent probes during a scan\.



*Type:*
positive integer, meaning >0



*Default:*

```nix
256
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.exclusive



Make this daemon the only substituter of the host\. Nix then never
talks to an upstream cache directly, and all substitution goes through
this daemon, which prefers LAN peers and verifies upstream narinfos
when ` services.nix-cache-discovery.verifyFallbackSignatures `
is enabled\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
true
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.extraArgs



Extra command line arguments for nix-cache-discovery\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.fallbackSubstituters



Upstream binary caches consulted only after the local store and all
live LAN peers\. Their narinfos are verified when
` services.nix-cache-discovery.verifyFallbackSignatures ` is
enabled, then proxied, so their NARs also travel through this host\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*

```nix
[
  "https://cache.nixos.org"
]
```



*Example:*

```nix
[
  "https://cache.nixos.org"
]
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.listenAddress



Address the HTTP(S) server binds to\.



*Type:*
string



*Default:*

```nix
"0.0.0.0"
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.openFirewall



Open the cache port in the firewall\. With discovery\.auto enabled the
port is opened to private, link-local and unique-local addresses; the
daemon’s runtime allowlist still restricts clients to the connected
subnet\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
true
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.port



Port used both to serve the cache and to scan for peers\.
Every host that should discover each other must use the same port\.



*Type:*
16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive)



*Default:*

```nix
5000
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.priority



Binary cache priority advertised in nix-cache-info\.



*Type:*
signed integer



*Default:*

```nix
30
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.proxy\.retries



Number of extra attempts per upstream source when it times out or
answers with a server error\. Clients receive a retryable error only
after all sources and attempts are exhausted\.



*Type:*
unsigned integer, meaning >=0



*Default:*

```nix
3
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.proxy\.timeout



Seconds allowed for each upstream narinfo request before it is
retried\. Slow caches are waited for instead of being treated as a
miss, so clients do not fall back to building\.



*Type:*
positive integer, meaning >0



*Default:*

```nix
30
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.proxy\.wait



Seconds a request may be held while no cache source is reachable\.
This keeps a client waiting through a short network drop instead of
failing the build\. Keep it below the client’s stalled download
timeout\.



*Type:*
positive integer, meaning >0



*Default:*

```nix
120
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.publicIpUrl



URL that returns the public IP of the current network as plain text\.
Only used when
` services.nix-cache-discovery.trustedNetworks ` is non-empty\.



*Type:*
string



*Default:*

```nix
"https://api.ipify.org"
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.publicKey



Public half of ` services.nix-cache-discovery.signingKeyFile `\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"household-cache-1:base64..."
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.signingKeyFile



Optional binary cache signing key\. When unset, this host does not sign
narinfos and Nix trusts its local daemon directly through
` nix.settings.require-sigs ` = false\. When set, narinfos are signed and
` services.nix-cache-discovery.publicKey ` is added to
` nix.settings.trusted-public-keys ` instead\.



*Type:*
null or absolute path



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.tls\.enable



Whether to enable TLS for the cache and for peer communication\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.tls\.certFile



TLS certificate used for HTTPS\.



*Type:*
null or absolute path



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.tls\.keyFile



TLS private key used for HTTPS\.



*Type:*
null or absolute path



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.trustCheckInterval



Seconds between public IP checks\.



*Type:*
positive integer, meaning >0



*Default:*

```nix
60
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.trustedNetworks



Public IP addresses (or prefixes) of networks where this daemon may
serve and discover peers\. On any other network it stops discovery,
drops known peers and refuses every non-loopback client, while
loopback keeps working\. Empty disables the check\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```



*Example:*

```nix
[
  "203.0.113.7"
]
```



## services\.nix-cache-discovery\.verifyFallbackSignatures



Verify narinfo signatures from
` services.nix-cache-discovery.fallbackSubstituters ` against
` nix.settings.trusted-public-keys ` before proxying them\. LAN peers are
not checked because they are trusted by network membership, not by a
distributed key\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
true
```
